title: Q&A with Claude Code creator and head Boris Cherny on how the title "software engineer" is disappearing, why AI may create more jobs than it destroys, and more (Casey Newton/Platformer)
summary: Casey Newton / Platformer: Q&A with Claude Code creator and head Boris Cherny on how the title “software engineer” is disappearing, why AI may create more jobs than it destroys, and more — Anthropic's Boris Cherny tells me major job loss due to automation really is coming — but job creation is, too.
